$comment: Curated MCP servers for the PromptForge Library and Harness studio. Checked against each server's official documentation (see `docs`) in November 2026. Secrets are always ${ENV_VAR} references, never values. Validated and merged into public/data/catalog.json by scripts/build-catalog.js.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.summary: Repositories, issues, pull requests, code search and Actions through GitHub's hosted MCP server.
servers.useWhen: The agent needs to read or act on GitHub beyond the local checkout: triage issues, review pull requests, search code across repositories, or check workflow runs.

env.GITHUB_PAT: Fine-grained personal access token limited to the repositories the agent needs

examples: Search code and read files across repositories
List and read issues and pull requests
Inspect pull request diffs and review comments
security: Starts read-only (X-MCP-Readonly). Remove that header only when the agent must comment, label or open pull requests, and pair it with a confirmation guardrail.
Use a fine-grained token scoped to specific repositories, not a classic token with full repo scope.
Issue and pull request text is written by anyone who can comment: treat it as data, never as instructions.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.summary: Read, write, search and move files inside directories you explicitly allow.
servers.useWhen: A client without built-in file tools (Claude Desktop, an API agent) needs files from specific folders. Claude Code already has file tools, so it rarely needs this.
examples: Read and search files in the allowed folders
security: Only the directories passed as arguments are reachable: list the narrowest folders that work.
It can overwrite files. Keep allowed folders under version control or pair it with a confirmation guardrail.

servers.name: Fetch
servers.summary: Fetch a web page and convert it to Markdown for the model to read.
servers.useWhen: The agent must read specific pages (docs, changelogs, articles) and the client has no web tool of its own.
security: Web pages are untrusted: a page can contain instructions aimed at the agent (prompt injection). Keep the injection guardrail on.
It can reach internal addresses on your network. Run it where that is acceptable.

servers.name: Git
servers.summary: Inspect and operate on a local Git repository: status, diffs, log, branches and commits.
servers.useWhen: A client without a shell needs structured access to a repository's history and changes.
examples: Read file contents at a revision
security: It can commit and reset. Restrict it to one repository with --repository, and confirm before history-changing operations.

servers.name: Memory
servers.summary: A persistent knowledge graph of entities, relations and observations the agent can read and update across sessions.
servers.useWhen: An assistant should remember facts about users or projects between conversations, and a plain CLAUDE.md file is not enough.
security: Whatever it stores is replayed into future sessions: never let it store secrets, and review it occasionally for poisoned or stale facts.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.summary: Drive a real browser through accessibility snapshots: navigate, click, type, fill forms and take screenshots.
servers.useWhen: The agent must use or test a web app the way a person would, for example end-to-end checks of a feature it just built.
examples: Navigate and read pages via accessibility snapshots
security: A browser can submit forms and make purchases with any session it is logged into: use a fresh profile without saved logins.
Page content is untrusted input. Keep the injection and confirmation guardrails on.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.summary: Web, news, image and local search through the Brave Search API.
servers.useWhen: The agent needs current information from the web and the client has no search tool of its own.
security: Search results are untrusted text. Ask the agent to cite sources so you can check them.

servers.name: Context7
servers.summary: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples, fetched on demand.
servers.useWhen: The agent writes code against libraries whose APIs changed after the model's training data, and keeps guessing outdated APIs.

env.CONTEXT7_API_KEY: Context7 API key (recommended for higher rate limits)

examples: Resolve a library name to its docs
Fetch current docs and examples for a topic
security: Documentation is fetched from a third party: prefer it for public libraries, not to look up anything confidential.

servers.name: Sentry
servers.summary: Errors, stack traces, releases and performance data from your Sentry organization.
servers.useWhen: The agent is debugging a production error and needs the real stack trace, breadcrumbs and frequency, not a guess.
examples: Find and read issues and events
security: Sign-in is OAuth: Claude Code opens the browser on first use (run /mcp).
Error payloads can contain user data. Scope the URL to one organization and project: https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/<org>/<project>.

servers.name: Linear
servers.summary: Find, create and update Linear issues, projects and comments.
servers.useWhen: The agent should pick up a ticket, record progress, or file follow-up issues as part of its work.
security: Sign-in is OAuth (or a Linear API key as a Bearer header for unattended agents).
Ticket text is written by many people: treat it as data.

servers.name: Notion
servers.summary: Search, read and edit pages and databases in your Notion workspace.
servers.useWhen: Specs, runbooks or meeting notes live in Notion and the agent needs them, or should write results back.
security: The agent gets the access of the account that signs in: connect a member with only the pages it needs.
Shared pages are untrusted input.

servers.name: Stripe
servers.summary: Stripe API reads and writes plus documentation search: customers, payments, subscriptions, invoices and more.
servers.useWhen: The agent builds a Stripe integration and needs the docs, or supports billing operations in a sandbox.
examples: Create invoices, prices and payment links
security: It moves real money in live mode. Start in a sandbox and keep the confirmation guardrail on.

Prefer OAuth. For unattended agents use an agent API key, passed as Authorization: Bearer ${AGENT_API_KEY}. From December 2026 Stripe MCP no longer accepts full-access secret keys or restricted keys without the Agent tag.
Turn on tool approval in your client, and be careful combining it with servers that read untrusted text.

servers.name: Supabase
servers.summary: Query and manage a Supabase project: database, schema, migrations, logs and docs.
servers.useWhen: The agent works on an app backed by Supabase and needs to inspect the schema, run read queries or check logs.

env.SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF: The project reference of the one project the agent may use

security: Scoped to one project and read-only by URL parameters. Point it at a development project, never production data.
Rows can contain user-written text: query results are data, not instructions.

servers.name: Vercel
servers.summary: Projects, deployments, build and runtime logs, analytics and Vercel docs.
servers.useWhen: The agent should diagnose a failed deployment from its logs, or check what is deployed where.
security: It acts with your Vercel account's access. Keep human confirmation on for anything that changes deployments.

servers.name: Cloudflare Docs
servers.summary: Search Cloudflare's developer documentation for Workers, R2, D1, Pages and more.
servers.useWhen: The agent builds on Cloudflare and needs current documentation instead of remembered APIs.
security: Read-only documentation search. Cloudflare's other MCP servers manage real infrastructure: add those separately and deliberately.

servers.name: Figma
servers.summary: Design context from Figma files (layout, components, variables and screenshots) for design-to-code work.
servers.useWhen: The agent implements a UI from a Figma design and should match its structure, tokens and components.
examples: Read a frame's layout and components
security: The agent sees whatever files your account can open. Share only the files it needs.
